# LCARS-WebUI

> LCARS-WebUI 7.0.0 is a Python library for building live, browser-rendered LCARS interfaces. Python declares the interface, Pydantic models define a versioned manifest, FastAPI serves it, and a bundled React frontend renders code-native LCARS geometry. No HTML, CSS, or JavaScript required to build an application.

Start with `lcars new my-app`. An application is an `App`: pages are declared once with `@app.page`, widgets come from `lcars_ui.ui` (or `lcars_ui.advanced` for specialist surfaces), and interactions are handled by `@app.action` receiving a typed `ActionContext`. The renderer composes the screen from semantic LCARS panels; placement hints only direct the automatic result.

For the complete text of every page below in a single file, see [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/blob/main/llms-full.txt).

## Learn

- [Home](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Home): Start here: what the library builds, the mental model, and a minimal app.
- [Getting Started](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Getting-Started): Install, run an example, and build a first app.
- [Build a Dashboard](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Build-a-Dashboard): Follow a complete multi-page dashboard tutorial.
- [Concepts](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Concepts): Understand `App`, pages, actions, IDs, state, and transport.

## Authoring

- [Layouts](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Layouts): Choose page archetypes, containers, zones, and sizing hints.
- [Surface Engine](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Surface-Engine): Build arbitrary-topology screens - arcs, polygons, mirrored consoles, effects.
- [Widgets](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Widgets): Find every supported widget family and its capabilities.
- [Knowledge Graph](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Knowledge-Graph): Use the surviving support-panel and tri-state instruments.
- [Graph Workspace](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Graph-Workspace): Build generic proposal authoring and density navigation.
- [Actions and State](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Actions-and-State): Handle controls, forms, table state, effects, and live updates.
- [Recipes](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Recipes): Copy practical authoring patterns.

## Reference

- [Reference](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Reference): Look up public entry points, accepted values, and routes.
- [Deployment](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Deployment): Configure HTTPS, auth, limits, uploads, and reverse proxies.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Troubleshooting): Diagnose install, state, upload, layout, and transport issues.
- [Visual Gallery](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/wiki/Visual-Gallery): Inspect code-rendered example output.

## Package reference

- [docs/quickstart.md](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/blob/main/lcars-ui/docs/quickstart.md): Install, create a virtual environment, and run a first app.
- [docs/dsl.md](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/blob/main/lcars-ui/docs/dsl.md): Full Python DSL surface: pages, panels, widgets, state, effects.
- [docs/widgets.md](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/blob/main/lcars-ui/docs/widgets.md): Every widget signature and its typed capability options.
- [docs/surface.md](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/blob/main/lcars-ui/docs/surface.md): Surface Engine: arcs, rings, elbows, paths, transforms, effects.
- [docs/deployment.md](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/blob/main/lcars-ui/docs/deployment.md): HTTPS, token auth, CORS, rate limits, uploads, reverse proxies.
- [docs/lcars_language.md](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/blob/main/lcars-ui/docs/lcars_language.md): Colour, typography, and geometry rules of the visual language.
- [README.md](https://github.com/darsrc/LCARS-WebUI/blob/main/lcars-ui/README.md): Package overview, runtime model, and development commands.
